title: 今天是不是送了全量重置卡
excerpt: Claude - @Lukedis - 怎么多了张全量重置卡
content_html:
Full reset
Expires Dec 11, 6:00 AM GMT+8

Fable reset
Expires Nov 17, 3:59 PM GMT+8
Refills your 5-hour limit and your Fable allowance, and gives back what Fable used on your weekly limit. It doesn’t reset your whole week.
